message: How much water does rice need?
reply: Rice requires about 1200 to 2000 mm of total water for its growth. It needs standing water of about 2 to 5 cm in the field for most of its crop cycle. Keeping the field puddled and flooded helps control weeds and ensures good growth. If you have any other questions about your crop, please let me know.

message: Gehu kab boni chahiye?

message: Is it a good week to sow wheat in Rewa?
reply: It is a bit early for wheat sowing in Rewa. The best sowing window starts in late October and continues through November. Temperatures right now are still around 30 degrees Celsius, which is slightly warm for wheat germination. It is better to wait another week or two for cooler weather. Prepare your field well, select certified disease-resistant seeds, and ensure good soil moisture before you begin sowing later this month.

message: Bhopal me kal baarish hogi kya, sinchai karu?

message: Mandla me soybean me khad kab dalu?

message: Soyabean me kida laga hai, kya karu?

message: Cotton mein pink bollworm ka attack ho gaya hai

message: The leaves of my maize plants are curling. Why?
reply: Maize leaves curling can happen due to water stress from dry weather, heat, or pest attacks like stem borers or armyworms. Please check if the soil is too dry or if you see small pests inside the whorls. Ensure your crop gets enough moisture and monitor the field regularly. message: How much wheat seed is required per acre?
reply: Generally, for timely sown wheat, about 40 kilograms of quality seeds are required per acre. If sowing is delayed, you may need around 50 kilograms per acre to maintain proper plant population. Ensure seeds are treated before sowing and sown at a depth of 4 to 5 centimeters in well-prepared soil.

message: Urea aur DAP fertilizer mein kya difference hai?
reply: Namaste! Urea aur DAP (Di-ammonium Phosphate) dono alag fertilizer hain. Urea mein mukhya roop se Nitrogen hoti hai, jo paudhon ki hari patton aur tezi se vikas ke liye zaroori hai. DAP mein Nitrogen ke saath-sath Phosphorus bhi hoti hai, jo paudhon ki jadon ke mazboot vikas aur phool-phal aane mein madad karti hai. Fasal aur mitti ki jaanch ke anusaar hi inka prayog karein. message: Madhya Pradesh mein kam paani wali kaun si fasal uga sakte hain?

Kharif mein aap soybean, jowar, bajra, arhar, moong ya urad uga sakte hain, jise kam sinchai ki zaroorat padti hai. Rabi mein chana, masoor, sarson aur alsi (linseed) behtar vikalp hain jo kam nami mein bhi achhi पैदाwar de sakte hain. Fasal chunne se pehle apni jagah ki mitti ki jaanch zaroor karwayein aur najdeekhi krishi vigyan kendra se salah lein.

message: Meri sarson ki fasal mein aphids lag gaye hain

Agar samasya zyada hai, toh kripya apne nazdeekhi Krishi Vigyan Kendra ya kheti visheshagya se sampark karein aur rashaynik dava ka prayog karne se pehle label ki janch zaroor karein.

message: Kya neem oil use kar sakta hoon?

Iske chhidkaav ke liye neem oil ko paani aur halki matra mein sabun ke ghol ke sath milakar subah ya sham ke samay khet mein spray karein. message: My soil is salty. Which crops might grow better in it?
reply: Namaste. Salty or saline soils have high salt content, which affects water absorption by plants. Crops like barley, cotton, pearl millet, sorghum, and mustard tolerate salinity better than other crops. Before sowing, it helps to improve drainage and apply organic matter like compost.
